name: Choir Aahs
author: Frank Wen (FluidR3 GM SoundFont) / packaged for DAW
source: FluidR3_GM.sf2 "Ahh Choir" (bank 0, program 52), Debian package fluid-soundfont-gm 3.1-6 (http://deb.debian.org/debian/pool/main/f/fluid-soundfont/)
attribution: Choir samples from the Fluid R3 GM SoundFont by Frank Wen (2000-2002, 2008) and Toby Smithe (2008), MIT license.
desc: Mixed choir singing "aah", sustained and looped, stereo, MIDI 36-84. Pads, hymns, cinematic swells, soft vocal harmony under melodies; hold long notes. | Playable MIDI 36-84 (C2-C6), 1 velocity layer. Params: human 0-1 (timing/level/pitch life), velcurve (velocity response), keytrack/bright (tone follows pitch/velocity).
